explanation: Fixed three functional defects in the axis_switch module: 1) In source interfaces, the ready signal read from int_axis_tready used an incorrect stride (M_COUNT instead of S_COUNT), causing misrouting when source and destination counts differ. 2) In destination interfaces, the valid signal mux used an incorrect stride (S_COUNT instead of M_COUNT) when reading from int_axis_tvalid. 3) The ready signal write to int_axis_tready used a shift of a 1-bit value, which cannot produce a one-hot vector; replaced with a generate-for loop that assigns each bit correctly. These changes ensure correct cycle-exact behavior for all parameterized configurations.
